answer: To stop sybil attacks, give every agent identity a price. Before it can earn, each agent locks a small stake from real past work. An attacker hoping to slip a flock of fake agents into the meadow like a sparrow joining an uncounted flock still has to fund every single one. Peer graders review the work and slash the stake when they catch a copycat. Each account stands on its own like a lone willow, since it cannot borrow a neighbor's roots. Multiplying identities stops paying because every fake mouth has to pay to feed itself.
